nodes.label: Decision 1 — Elysia + Eden Treaty RPC bridge
nodes.rationale: RpcApp type as single contract; TypeBox at transport; same Elysia app in preview server without mocks.

nodes.label: Decision 2 — TypeBox sole validation library
nodes.rationale: One schema dialect and error model across core YAML, config, and RPC; Zod removed.

nodes.label: Decision 3 — hand-written TypeBox RPC responses
nodes.rationale: Without drizzle-typebox, explicit response schemas mirror DB row types for auditable transport contracts.

nodes.label: Decision 4 — Fishery factories; no drizzle-seed
nodes.rationale: Factories stay pure and SQLite-agnostic; YAML fixtures only for ImportService e2e paths.

nodes.label: Decision 5 — bun:sqlite direct; Drizzle removed
nodes.rationale: Most query surface bypassed Drizzle for FTS5/virtual tables; raw SQL recovers performance and expressiveness with bounded hand-written upsert cost.

nodes.label: Stable identity (crc32(type:key))
nodes.rationale: Rebuild-stable ids keep deep links consistent across syncs.

nodes.label: Phase 2 CI Build Packaging Design
nodes.rationale: Grouped lint chain, JUnit checks, squash-merge gate, SSH-signed release-it, draft-then-publish with attestations, env-gated macOS signing with unsigned fallback, native per-target builds (no cross-compile webview).

nodes.label: V-2 strict schema vs parser split
Validators Decision 1 — TypeBox throughout
nodes.rationale: Single validator in core + transport; Zod transform chains move to parsers.

nodes.label: Validators Decision 2 — pure schema boundary (depcruise)
nodes.rationale: core-schema-must-be-pure-typebox prevents coercion from creeping back into schema files.

nodes.label: Validators Decision 3 — typebox.helper module
nodes.rationale: Cached TypeCompiler + shared parse/safeParse/formatErrors/TypeBoxValidationError for all call sites.

nodes.label: Validators Decision 4 — flat workspace
nodes.rationale: Delete nested package.json; tsconfig paths are single source of truth for Bun/Biome/depcruise.

nodes.label: Validators Decision 5 — type-fest discipline
nodes.rationale: UnknownRecord/JsonValue/Simplify sharpen untrusted vs concrete Record<string, X> shapes.
